item.title: Celtic take the points at Killie
item.description: Celtic came from 2-nil down to claim a stunning 3-2 victory at Kilmarnock thanks to a 97th minute winner. It keeps the Scottish Premiership champions in the hunt to retain their title. Fourth placed Motherwell beat Aberdeen 2-nil. Advertisement

item.title: Man further remanded in custody in relation to alleged attempted robbery of Tralee bookies
item.description: A Kerry man who had his High Court bail revoked has been remanded in custody for two weeks. John Paul Farrell of Muckross Road, Killarney appeared before Tralee District Court via video-link from Cork Prison. The 47-year-old is charged with attempted robbery, contrary to common law, at Boylesports on Edward Street in Tralee, on November 1st. item.title: Killarney councillor says sports capital grant payment system is crippling small clubs
item.description: A county councillor in Killarney says the way sports capital grants are paid is putting small clubs under severe financial pressure Councillor Niall “Botty” O’Callaghan told a recent Kerry County Council meeting that funding under the Community Sport Facilities Fund is only paid after projects are completed, forcing clubs to spend money they do not have upfront. item.title: Flexachem win
item.description: Team Flexachem won 88-86 at Neptune in the Dominos Men’s Super League. Garvey’s Tralee Warriors lost 88-85 to Sligo. Advertisement

item.title: Irish competitor 48th
item.description: Anabelle Zurbay completed her Olympic debut with a clean run in Milan Cortina. The 17 year old finished her day in the Giant Slalom with a time of 2:31.70, ending up in 48th overall. Her second run improved from her first which left her in 58th position. Advertisement The teenager, with family links in Westmeath, was the youngest competitor on the slopes this morning.

item.title: France win at Wales
item.description: Wales have suffered a 54-12 defeat to defending champions France in rugby union's Six Nations. It's a second heavy loss in a row for Steve Tandy's side, after they were thrashed 48-7 by England last weekend. France claim another bonus point thanks to an eight-try performance in Cardiff.
